## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Lisbon, Portugal. It starts at Largo Luís de Camões.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Explore Lisbon's nightlife with this pub crawl and enjoy a night of music and parties. Let local guides take you through the city's lively bars and clubs.
>
> First, visit a bar to start the tour with a welcome shot. Head to the second bar for an hour of free beer and sangria. At the third bar, have an extra shot before heading out. Finish off with a skip-the-line, VIP entry to a popular club.
>
> From there, explore the most iconic neighborhoods, Pink Street, Bairro Alto, and Cais do Sodre. You can also upgrade to premium spirits like gin, vodka, whiskey, and rum (available with Premium and Legendary Editions).

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €21.88. It was rated 5.0 out of 5 from 10 ratings and 10 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
